requirement text: The project shall remove this main problem (pain point): Set-up times eat 25 % of machine time.
Role of the author company in this project: Integrator. The scope split shall be fixed in the scope matrix.
The system shall be expandable for: +2 product families in 3 years (reserve space, modular design, open software).
The system shall manufacture these part families / products: Crankcases VC10/20/30 (cast iron).
The system shall handle 12 different part numbers without hardware change.
The system shall accept parts up to this size and mass: 400 × 350 × 300 mm, 28 kg.
The system shall process these materials / raw-part conditions: EN-GJL-250 castings.
The system shall reach these tolerances and surface values: Bore Ø52 H7, flatness 0.02, Ra 0.8.
The system shall be designed for these annual volumes (now -> in 5 years): VC20: 4 000 → 9 000 / year.
The system shall run economically with these lot / order sizes and frequencies: 20–60 per order, weekly.
The system shall support a delivery lead time of ≤ 5 working days.
The system shall be designed for this working time: 2 shifts + 1 unmanned, 240 days.
The system shall perform these process steps (routing, estimated times): OP10 rough 8 min, OP20 finish 6 min, wash 2 min.
The process domain of the system is: Machining (prismatic).
Changeover situation today (baseline): 90 min, 12 per week. The supplier shall state the guaranteed changeover time in the offer.
The fixture concept shall be: Dedicated tombstones per model.
The tool concept shall cover: 120 tools, 30 sister tools.
Inspection shall be done as follows: CMM first part + 1 in 10.
Traceability level: Serial + process data.
The system and its documentation shall support these standards: ISO 9001.
These existing machines shall be integrated: 2 × HMC Fanuc 31i, 2015, Ethernet.
Only these company standard brands shall be used: Siemens S7-1500, Fanuc robots.
Only these networks and protocols shall be used: Ethernet + Modbus TCP + HTTP only.
The system shall connect to this existing software: ERP: Odoo; no MES.
Material flow in and out: Euro pallets by forklift.
Storage capacity shall be at least: 40 raw, 20 WIP pallets.
Internal transport: Forklift → AGV wanted.
The layout shall fit into: 40 × 18 m, 8 m, 10 t crane.
Existing floor: 200 mm concrete, ±5 mm / 2 m. The supplier shall state any extra foundation requirement.
The system shall run with these utilities: 400 V 50 Hz, 400 kVA, 7 bar.
The system shall keep accuracy and function in this climate: 15–35 °C, no air-con.
The system shall be operable by: 2 operators, CNC basic, local language; HMI language and training shall match.
In-house skills: 1 electrician, no PLC programmer. The supplier shall provide training / service to cover the gaps.
The system shall comply with: EU – Machinery Regulation (EU) 2023/1230.
The safety concept shall cover these special risks: Parts 28 kg → no manual lifting.
The system shall follow these IT security rules: No internet on shop floor; VPN by IT only.
The system shall record and keep this data: OEE + alarms + energy, 2 years.
Budget range and payback target: 2.5–3.2 M€, payback ≤ 7 years.
The project shall meet these target dates: Order 03/2027, full output 09/2028.
The supplier shall guarantee these KPIs: ≥ 14 parts/h, availability ≥ 95 %.
